fields.description: Users having any of these roles open the Business Intelligence Dashboard after login (only if they are also permitted to open it). Leave empty to disable the redirect.
fields.label: Roles landing on the dashboard

fields.description: How long dashboard results are cached. Posting or cancelling a transaction clears the cache immediately.
fields.label: Cache Duration (minutes)

fields.description: Customer invoices overdue by at least this many days raise an alert.
fields.label: Overdue Invoice Days

fields.description: A customer whose outstanding is at least this amount is flagged.
fields.label: High Outstanding Amount

fields.description: Net profit margin below this percentage raises an alert.
fields.label: Low Profit Margin (%)

fields.description: An expense account growing by at least this percentage vs the previous period is flagged.
fields.label: Unusual Expense Increase (%)

fields.description: Sales falling by at least this percentage vs the previous period raise an alert.
fields.label: Sales Decline (%)

fields.description: Undelivered Sales Orders older than this many days are flagged.
fields.label: Pending Sales Order Age (days)

fields.description: Purchase Orders this many days past their schedule date are flagged.
fields.label: Delayed Purchase Order (days)

fields.description: Look-back window used to classify items as fast / slow / non moving.
fields.label: Movement Window (days)

fields.description: Items with at most this many outgoing transactions in the window are slow moving.
fields.label: Slow Moving Max Transactions
